notes: Encoded ONLY from Haier's own page. Ownership history on the page supplies no serial rule and none is derived from it. SHIPPED: page Style 3 only. HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (year = 2nd-position letter, month = 1st-position letter, both chart-only) and page Style 2 (year = 14th position, month = 15th, day = 16th, all chart-only) — see report image-pass. COUNTING for Style 3: digit-only counting is FALSIFIED (4th & 5th numerical digits would be '83', an invalid month), so character-position counting ships.

styles.era: 10-character normalized serials, letter + 4 digits + letter + 3 digits + letter, year + month (page style 3)
styles.notes: Year = 2nd & 3rd positions -> [1,3] -> '12' -> 2012; month = 4th & 5th positions -> [3,5] -> '08'. Digit-only counting falsified: 4th & 5th numerical digits would be '83' (invalid month). The page says this style uses 10-or-11 characters, but only the 10-character normalized form is documented by the example, so only that form is encoded; an undocumented 11-character variant fails the pattern safely (cannot determine) rather than decoding wrongly.
